help.pollInterval: Instant updates come from the file watcher; this only drives stale-session cleanup and acts as a backstop when the watcher misses events.
help.terminalPostOpenCommand: Executed automatically after cd-ing into the repo. Leave empty to only cd. e.g. add_proxy or ./bootstrap.sh; join multiple commands with &&, e.g. add_proxy && npm run dev.
help.startupCodeCli: Automatically run the selected coding CLI (e.g. claude) when the shell is ready after opening the embedded terminal for a task. "None" opens a plain shell
help.scrollbackRows: How many lines of history output you can scroll back through in the terminal. Applies immediately after saving. Larger values allow more history at higher memory cost

placeholder.workspaceBaseDir: Not set. Pick a directory to use as the workspace base directory

help.workspaceBaseDir: Task working directories live under this base (directory name = task ID). Both embedded and external terminals use it as the base

help.httpServerPort: Leave empty to use the default port ({{port}}). Range 3000–10000. Manually restart the service on the status page to apply.
